source_caption_text:
#YoungThug is using his own experiences to encourage the next generation to make different choices💯

Over the weekend, the Atlanta rapper spent time with teens and young men at Atlanta’s Next Level Boys Academy, a mentorship program supporting young men involved in the court system.

Speaking from personal experience, Young Thug encouraged the young men to think beyond the moment and understand the long-term consequences of the choices they make. He opened up about spending nearly three years sitting in a courtroom and shared a simple message: “It ain’t worth it, bro.”

The conversation comes at the intersection of mentorship, second chances and breaking cycles that can impact young men and their communities. Rather than simply telling them what not to do, the moment offered an opportunity for young people to hear directly from someone who has experienced the consequences firsthand.
